title: H1 Fieldwork Questions by Topic
doc: 2a H1 Fieldwork Questions by Topic v0.5.docx

sections.title: 1. What this doc is and how it was built
bullets: All H1 Section A fieldwork questions (Q1, 30 marks): 41 questions from 41 school-years, with 166 diagrams.
Grouped under Cluster 2: Fieldwork by syllabus fieldwork area – Community response to CC (15), Elderly needs (17), Others (9) – then by school and year.
Question wording is copied from each school's question paper (typed text, not screenshots). Diagrams are cropped from the school's Insert.

sections.title: 2. Assumptions
bullets: Diagrams for a question are the resources its wording refers to (e.g. 'Resources 1 and 2'), not the Insert's 'for Question N' labels. For example, the YIJC 2024 Insert labels Resource 7 'for Question 1' by mistake, so it is left out.

Word files (EJC 2024, JPJC 2024, SAJC 2024–2026, CJC/DHS/RI/TJC/TMJC 2026) were converted to PDF with LibreOffice before extracting text and cropping, so line breaks and spacing can differ slightly from the printed paper.
The section line is standardised to 'Section A — Cluster 2 Fieldwork' (NYJC 2025 keeps its own title).
Diagrams are compressed (max 1300 px, JPEG or 256-colour PNG) to keep the file small (21 MB). Fine print in dense tables may be slightly softer than the original.
VJC 2026 is left out (password-protected question paper). MI 2026, NJC 2024 and RVHS 2024–2026 have no H1 paper.
Which fieldwork area a question is in follows doc 1; the 'Others' list and the inconsistent filings are in doc 1's review notes.

sections.title: 3. To review: text and layout
sections.note: Places where the typed question text or the cropped diagram is not a perfect copy of the paper.

rows: A small table in the question (elderly population by age group) is typed as one line of text.
The respondent breakdown by age group is typed as one line of text.
The last bullet of the list of observation sites ('Alison Park') runs into the next sentence.
Bullet points (●) appear inline in the text instead of as a list.
Resource 1 and 2 crops include the page number / '[Turn over' at the bottom.
Insert crops show a grey margin on the right (left over from Word comment bubbles in the school's file).
Some crops may still include the school's page footer line.

sections.title: 4. To consider
bullets: Tag each sub-part with its fieldwork stage from the syllabus (pre-fieldwork: question/hypothesis, planning, ethics, risks; data collection; post-fieldwork: presentation, analysis, evaluation). This would let students practise, say, all 'risk' questions together.
Start each school's question on a new page for printing.
Use screenshots of the question paper instead of typed text, for an exact copy of tables and layout (larger file, not searchable).
Add a contents list at the start (school and year, with page numbers).
